title: Owner pins the demo flight at three moments and compares with the video
goal: Run the B-017 check on the live site and reply pass or the failing step
acceptance: The owner replies pass, or names the failing step and what was seen
privacy: The owner's reply is recorded without coordinates, addresses or private flight data
